entities.summary: The Tecnológico de Antioquia (TdeA), also called Tecnológico de Antioquia – University Institute, is an academic institution of higher education in Colombia in the department of Antioquia, provides technical education services, technology and professional. Its headquarters are located in the commune Robledo, in the city of Medellín.
